Respondent No. 5 to 7 are R/o. Sathupally, Khammam District ...

RESPONDENTS Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased toto issue a Writ, Order or Direction, more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus, declaring action of the Respondents No. 2 and 3 in not taking any action on petitioners complaint, dated 27.11.2012 lodged against the Respondent No.5 to 7 who abused the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, and collected large scale of amounts by deceiving the illiterate poor tribals compensation amounts, taking advantage of the dismal legal literacy of the tribal population in the acquisition of land for the Indira Sagar Project, popularized as Polavaram Project, as per law as being illegal,
arbitrary, unconstitutional, colorable exercise of power and violation of Articles 14, 19 (1) (g) and 21 of the Constitution of India I.A. NO: 1 OF 2014(WPMP. NO: 9755 OF 2014) Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the respondents Nos. 2 and 3 to take action on petitioner's complaint dt.27. 11.2012 forthwith, pending disposal of the above writ Petition Counsel for the Kommena Muttamma, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, Rep By Its ...

Petitioner(s):SRI. RAM PRASAD GOUD TEEGALA Counsel for the Respondents: 2008/GP FOR REVENUE Counsel for the Respondents: GP FOR HOME
Counsel for the Respondents: 10727/K J V N PUNDAREEKAKSHUDU

The Court made the following Order:
None appeared for the petitioner.
On earlier occasions also, there is no representation on behalf of the petitioner either personally or through any advocate.

It seems that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the case.
2. Therefore, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel
, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
